newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan financial holding firm bill not ready yet.
newsitem.headline: Japan financial holding firm bill not ready yet.

text.p: Japan Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told a news conference on Thursday that proposed legislation to allow holding companies for financial firms will not be ready for the current session of parliament.
"It will be difficult to submit bills to the current session of the parliament, but we hope to have them ready as soon as possible," Ogawa said.
He also said that financial supervision agency which will take over MOF's supervision and inspection function of the financial sector will start April 1998.
He said that there would also be some combining of the Ministry's Banking and Securities bureaux and some of the functions of the International Finance Bureau.
